criteria.description: [REQ-1] `from app_int.main import subtract` succeeds without error, and `subtract` is callable.
[REQ-2] `inspect.signature(subtract)` lists exactly two parameters, named `a` and `b`, in that order.
[REQ-7] `subtract.__annotations__` maps `a` to `int`, `b` to `int`, and `return` to `int` (string or type form).
[REQ-8] At least one test function under `tests/` calls `subtract` and asserts on its return value, and that test passes under `uv run pytest -q`.
[REQ-9] At least one test under `tests/` asserts a `subtract` call whose expected result is negative.
[REQ-10] `health_check()` returns `{"status": "ok"}`, `add(2, 3)` returns `5`, and the pre-existing tests `test_health_check_reports_ok` and `test_add_returns_the_sum` are still present and pass.
[REQ-11] `uv run ruff check .` exits with status 0.
[REQ-12] The `dependencies` list in `pyproject.toml` is unchanged from the base branch (still empty).
